name: 3-D Matrix, Ltd.
summary: 3-D Matrix, Ltd. developing, manufacturing, and selling self-assembling peptide technology in Japan and internationally. It offers PuraMatrix, a self-assembling peptide hydrogel for use in the regenerative medicine, cell therapy, drug delivery systems, and other uses in various fields; and surfactant-like peptide, as well as High Concentration PuraMatrix, a high concentration hydrogel; and GMP Grade PuraMatrix. The company was incorporated in 2004 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.
